title: Advance through several stages on one native read with stage advance --to, and read native status once on the move into done (DRIVE-9, DRIVE-2)
description: Advance through several stages on one native read with stage advance --to, and read native status once on the move into done (DRIVE-9, DRIVE-2)
acceptance_criteria: Under a per-change session, 'chough stage advance --to accept' from plan on an approved change runs specsync change status once, records three advance events with their gate labels in applied.steps and ends at accept, and a single-checkpoint project appends the same three transitions. From intent, '--to plan' makes no native read. A refused step (blocking bug, draft state, a target not ahead, a side or unknown target, an open human gate) refuses the whole batch with at most one read, nothing recorded and the session file and history byte-identical. On an archived change with an acceptance manifest and the librarian on, 'stage advance' from accept to done and '--to done' from test each run specsync change status exactly once and report librarian_trim; before this change, accept to done ran it twice. A plain 'stage advance' is unchanged. The new-behavior tests fail against main first and pass after, and fledge lanes run verify passes.

answers.constraints: DRIVE-9 and DRIVE-2 (hi/drive.md, Leif's t811u words); Leif via the orc t18: 'Split' for PR #69 (2026-11-05 21:51 MST) and Q2 'Yes', the librarian at done reuses the gate's read (21:52 MST); the persistent archive cache is #32's (REQ-cli-053); every native read stays live and is shared only within one command; REQ-cli-052 taken per the orc's ID registry.
